nina: quick RFC follow-up re: priority TTLs + compactor contract. sketched a pragmatic enforcement model below.

lee: is priority binary or multi-tier?

nina: multi-tier (P0/P1/P2). TTL semantics same for all tiers. token cost varies by tier.

omar: guardrails: enforce per-tenant token budgets + global max-ttl. otherwise retention cost can spike.

rachel: propose defaults: default_high_ttl=30s, token refill=1/sec, costs P0=10,P1=3,P2=1, enterprise opt-in for max-ttl=24h.

dave: enforcement location? edge for routing speed, central for authoritative decisions. two-phase check seems right.

omar: yep. edge does best-effort token check and emits signed header. central ingress verifies and may emit downgrade flag + reason. must be deterministic.

nina: store expiry as epoch_ms in envelope header (x-rt-expiry-ms) and include x-rt-requested-priority, x-rt-effective-priority, x-rt-downgrade-reason when applicable.

rachel: compactor contract: preserve minimal priority fields until either expiry_ms passed OR central sets priority_revoked=true. do not evict solely on missing local header.

dave: to save index size, compactor should materialize only expiry_ms, effective_priority, original_priority, downgrade_code as compact enums/ints.

omar: legal/GDPR: priority must not bypass legal minima for retention or deletion. add to policy.

ingest-bot: ci-note: added unit tests for token-bucket + expiry parsing (PR #7950). :white_check_mark:

nina: action items: 1) product/legal max-ttl decision (nina) 2) ingest-controller prototype token-bucket + signed header (lee/omar) 3) compactor contract doc + minimal field set (rachel) 4) Console UX ticket for token visibility & emergency toggle (dave) 5) audit trail for downgrades and reclassify flow (omar).

rachel: will draft compactor contract and example envelope schema.

lee: prototype perf target: edge check <1ms p95; central verify a few ms.

dave: timeline: prototype this sprint, canary next week.

nina: i'll write a short addendum with header names, token costs, and enums, will ping for reviews.

omar: +1.

ingest-bot: deploy-note: ingest-controller prototype deployed to canary at 3899991138. smoke tests running. :rocket:
